metadata.title: Container Supply Chain

props.remarks: Business capability for ensuring the integrity, provenance, and trustworthiness of container images and artifacts prior to execution.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Container build pipelines, image registries, artifact repositories, and distribution mechanisms.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Establishes trust in container artifacts from build through distribution and deployment.

props.name: depends-on

props.name: nist-guidance

metadata.remarks: Container Supply Chain defines the trust properties required to ensure container images and related artifacts are authentic, untampered, and appropriate for deployment. This pattern addresses risks introduced prior to runtime, including malicious images, compromised build systems, and untrusted registries, without asserting runtime or orchestration controls.
